title: Unconditional type casting may crash
detail: This `else` runs when `path_type` is `None` or when the value is already an instance of `path_type`. In both cases calling `path_type(value)` is incorrect: if `path_type` is `None` it raises a `TypeError`, and if the value is already of the correct type it may still raise errors (e.g., `bytes(value)` on a string).

title: Incorrect type conversion logic
detail: The branch `if path_type is not str: rv = os.fsdecode(value)` incorrectly handles the `bytes` case because the `elif path_type is bytes` is unreachable. This causes `bytes` values to be decoded instead of encoded, leading to wrong types and potential runtime errors.
note: Names the planted `is not str` and its effect: the bytes branch becomes unreachable.

title: Incorrect logical operator in disabled progress stop
detail: The condition uses `or` instead of `and`, causing the progress display to print a blank line when either the console is non-interactive or not in Jupyter, even when `disable=True`. This defeats the purpose of disabling progress output.
note: Describes the planted `or` for `and` and the blank line it prints.
